about: One row per Deadlock hero playable as a Risk of Rain 2 survivor. Heights are the hero's body-mesh height in metres as exported from the player's own Deadlock install (VRF glTF, 1 Source unit = 0.0254 m), measured 2026-10-12 on Deadlock ClientVersion 6774. heightScale keeps Deadlock's relative sizes: every hero is scaled by one global factor (anchorHero's height -> Commando's model height), so heightScale = sourceHeight / anchor sourceHeight. passiveName/passiveDescription/passiveIcon: the hero's passive on the character select screen (what the gun already does on hit), or none. damageHealBack/damageHealBackTime: the passive heals back that fraction of every hit taken over that many seconds (Abrams' Infernal Resilience), 0 = none. debuffResist: timed debuffs on the hero last that fraction less. modelScale: an extra even scale on the model only (1 = Deadlock's relative size; Mo & Krill are scaled up to Abrams' height), so heightScale = sourceHeight x modelScale / anchor sourceHeight. capsuleFrom: a vanilla body whose movement capsule the hero copies instead of scaling Commando's (none = scaled), so a huge model still fits through every stage. cameraFrom / cameraScale / cameraRight: a vanilla body whose camera settings are copied (none = Commando's scaled by height), pushed back by cameraScale and to the right by cameraRight metres. interactRange: multiplies the reach for chests, shrines and the teleporter. immuneToForce: the hero can't be pushed, pulled or knocked back by enemy hits (vanilla ImmuneToPhysicsForces). riderBone: a bone carrying a second character on the model (Krill), hidden by scaling it to 0 while a buff with melee=true is on (he is away), or none. noFallDamage: the hero never takes fall damage (Viscous: goo lands soft). landShake: the amplitude of the screen shake after a heavy landing (2 = the usual; Viscous 0.2). voiceGain: the hero's voice lines' loudness on top of the usual (1 = the usual; Viscous 1.2). splitMeshes: meshes the extractor keeps as parts of their own instead of merging them into their material (Rat King's ammo belt, one mesh per round count, extractor 1.6.0+), or none. airJumpMult: the vertical speed of the jumps after the first is multiplied by this (Rat King's King's Leap: 1.3; 1 = the usual). gooMaterials/glassMaterials: model parts drawn as living goo / a clear glass helmet instead of the game material.

rows.subtitle: The Smoke-Shrouded Assassin
rows.passiveDescription: Every SMG hit stacks <style=cIsUtility>Fixation</style> on the target (up to 40, for 6s; <style=cIsDamage>critical hits stack 3</style>). Each stack makes that target take <style=cIsDamage>+2.5% damage</style> from Haze. Every 10 stacks the target bursts for <style=cIsDamage>300% damage</style>, splashing every enemy within 6m, and is <style=cIsUtility>slowed</style>.
rows.lore: Deadlock's twin-SMG assassin. Every hit stacks Fixation on her target, Smoke Bomb hides her, Sleep Dagger drops a target and Bullet Dance shreds everything around her.

rows.subtitle: The Unstoppable Detective
rows.passiveDescription: <style=cIsHealing>Heal back 10%</style> of all damage you take over 10s. Debuffs on you last <style=cIsUtility>20% shorter</style>.
rows.lore: Deadlock's brawler detective. He drains life with Siphon Life, crashes through enemies with Shoulder Charge, shrugs off damage with Infernal Resilience and lands from the sky with Seismic Impact.

rows.subtitle: The Living Storm
rows.passiveDescription: Your gun and Lightning Ball build <style=cIsUtility>Static</style> on enemies. At 10 stacks the target <style=cIsDamage>discharges for 300% damage</style>, arcing to 2 nearby enemies, and everything hit is <style=cIsUtility>stunned</style> for 1s.
rows.lore: Deadlock's lightning caster. He throws Lightning Balls, plants Static Charges that stun and rises into a Storm Cloud that shocks everything below.

rows.subtitle: The Burning Man
rows.passiveDescription: Gun hits build <style=cIsDamage>Afterburn</style>. At 12 stacks the target <style=cIsDamage>burns</style> for 100% damage per second for 3s.
rows.lore: Deadlock's arsonist. His bullets build Afterburn, Napalm's flask splashes a crowd with fire, Flame Dash leaves fire behind him and Concussive Combustion levels the room.

rows.subtitle: The Tunnel Rats
rows.passiveDescription: Mo is <style=cIsUtility>too heavy to be knocked back</style>, pushed or pulled by monsters. Krill rides on Mo and fires the <style=cIsDamage>Yellow Canary</style>. <style=cIsHealing>Every kill gives +2 max health</style> (+20 for a boss), up to +200. Max health only: a kill does not heal. Back to base at the start of every stage.
rows.lore: Deadlock's tunnel rats: Mo, the giant mole who digs, and Krill, who rides him and does the shooting and the talking. Sand Blast stops monsters fighting back, Burrow carries Mo under the ground, Dust Devil drags a whole pack around him and Tag Team throws Krill from enemy to enemy.

rows.subtitle: The Goo
rows.passiveDescription: Every goo hit stacks <style=cIsUtility>Gooed</style>: -8% movement and attack speed per stack, up to 5 (-40%; bosses half). <style=cIsUtility>Goo puddles</style> (Splatter, The Cube and Puddle Punch) last 3s, then shrink away over 5s. Each puddle holds <style=cIsDamage>20 rounds</style>: while you stand in it, it keeps your gun's magazine topped up, no reload needed, until its 20 are used up; hop to a fresh puddle for more. You and your allies move 30% faster on goo puddles. Viscous jumps a third higher and never takes fall damage.
rows.lore: Deadlock's psychic sea anemone in a suit of goo. Everything his goo touches gets Gooed and slows down: the blobs from his gun, Splatter's puddles, the Cube's tar tethers and the fist of Puddle Punch. Goo Ball turns whoever holds it into a huge rolling ball of goo.

rows.subtitle: The Sewer Sovereign
rows.passiveDescription: Rat King can <style=cIsUtility>double jump</style>, and the second jump goes <style=cIsUtility>30% higher</style>: a tucked spin with his cape swept up behind him.
rows.lore: Deadlock's king of the sewers, a giant rat in a cape with a belt-fed spreadshot and an army of rats. The Scrap Grenade blasts three times, hopping toward the nearest monster between blasts; Royal Pestments circles him with biting rats; Rule, Ratannia! leaps in and plants his banner; Rat Swarm sends fifty rats to latch on and bite.
